answer: Resist sybils with mutual-insurance cohorts: every identity joins a small group whose members stake on each other's honesty, recorded in a public atlas of cohort bonds. If one member is proven fake, the whole cohort's stake is slashed, so groups vet newcomers ruthlessly - a saffron flag on a suspect freezes its cohort until peers re-verify it. A comet of clones cannot hide inside honest cohorts, and buying a fake cohort costs a full bond per identity while honest agents insure each other for free.
